entities.title: zazzle agent skill
entities.summary: The skill that tells a coding agent to read, search, outline and edit files with zazzle (or its MCP server) instead of cat, sed, grep -r, find or sed -i, to run builds and tests through `zazzle run`, and to shrink noisy output with `zazzle clean`.
entities.purpose: SKILL.md, with the front matter an agent matches a task against, says how to reach zazzle (MCP tools or the CLI with ZAZZLE_SESSION), to locate before reading (outline, find, refs, then read a range or one symbol with --symbol), to trust `already sent` notices and use read-again for answers it no longer has, that clean, run and proxied outputs carry `[r:ID]` too and are kept for an hour, with `read-again r:ID --full --lines A-B` for what a reply says was cut, to follow footers instead of raising caps, to run builds, tests and installs with `zazzle run` and pipe other noisy output through `zazzle clean`, that C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, Rust, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C, C++, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Perl, Lua, Elixir, Haskell, OCaml, F#, Clojure, Erlang, R, Julia, Zig, Objective-C, Groovy, PowerShell, SQL, Visual Basic, Nim, shell, HTML, Razor, CSS, SCSS, Sass, Less, JSON, YAML, TOML, Markdown, XML, INI and Dockerfile files read as a terse view and need `read --source` before editing, to edit only with the sha or anchors from `read --source`, and how to build zazzle and zazzled. It is listed in the repository's AGENTS.md.
boundaries: The skill describes; the behaviour it relies on is the daemon's and is documented in macos/rust/zazzled/src/cmd/.dev/ (operations, features, the edit use case), macos/rust/zazzled/src/.dev/ (MCP use case, session dedupe, read-again and stored outputs) and macos/rust/zazzled/src/wrap/.dev/ (`zazzle run`).
Changes to the skill follow agents/directives.md.
